column1: # kit/perf/box/events.tsv: perf stat event lists per arch, read by
# rounds.sh -E SET. One ARCH<TAB>SET<TAB>EVENTS line per list; ARCH is
# what `uname -m` prints. Lines that start with # and empty lines are
# skipped. A port with its own lists passes its own file with -f.
# frontend: port A's aarch64 detail phase (instruction-side L1 refills,
# front- and back-end stalls, mispredicted branches). These are aarch64
# PMU event names; there is no x86-64 row because no port has an
# x86-64 list to take one from. With six counts it runs without -g:
# its lines are for a port's own table, not for stats (see rounds.sh).
